I now have a thorough picture. Here are my findings.

## Overview

This is a Spring PetClinic variant (OfficeFloor-based) where owner identity/hash generation lives in three places: the `util` package (pure algorithm helpers), the `rest/function/owner` package (pipeline steps that assign values), and the MapStruct `OwnerMapper` (which derives read-only DTO fields). The create-owner pipeline order is defined declaratively in `owners.POST.yml`.

Important cross-cutting note before the details: there is a **spec/implementation drift** worth your attention (see "Discrepancies" at the end) — the acceptance test and the OpenAPI descriptions do not match the current implementation.

---

## 1. Where customerCode, membershipNumber, checkDigit are defined

### Entity fields — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`
- Line 73-74: `@Column(name = "customer_code") private String customerCode;`
- Line 82-83: `@Column(name = "membership_number") private String membershipNumber;`
- Getters/setters: `getCustomerCode`/`setCustomerCode` (177-183), `getMembershipNumber`/`setMembershipNumber` (201-207).
- Note: `checkDigit` is **not** stored on the entity; it is a derived read-only value computed in the mapper. Related identity fields also here: `householdId` (76-77), `namesakeCount` (79-80), `possibleDuplicate`/`possibleDuplicateOf` (85-89).

### DTO fields — generated from `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/resources/openapi.yml`
The `OwnerDto` is code-generated from this spec (no hand-written `OwnerDto.java` exists in source). Field definitions:
- Line 2152-2160: `customerCode` (readOnly string)
- Line 2161-2170: `checkDigit` (readOnly integer 0-9, Luhn)
- Line 2171-2178: `membershipNumber` (readOnly string)
- Line 2179-2187: `fiscalYear` (`FY<YY>`)
- Line 2228-2234: `locality` (region)
- Line 2235-2242: `timezone`
- Line 2243-2251: `ownerSegment`
- (also `householdId` 2188-2196, `namesakeCount` 2197-2206, `membershipPoints` 2207-2217, `membershipLevel` 2218-2227)

---

## 2. How they are computed

### customerCode — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignCustomerCode.java`
Full logic (lines 27-49). Format `<REGION>-<HASH8>`:
- Line 33: `region = LocalityResolver.localityOf(owner.getPostcode(), owner.getCity())`
- Line 35: `hash8 = Sha256Hash.upperHex(normalizedTelephone + owner.getLastName(), 8)` (HASH_LENGTH=8, line 30)
- Line 36: `baseCode = region + "-" + hash8`
- Collision handling: lines 38-46 (see section 3).

### Region resolution — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/LocalityResolver.java`
- `localityOf(postcode, city)` lines 52-58: postcode range wins (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099 — `REGION_RANGE` lines 21-24), else city table (`CITY_REGION` lines 15-18), else `UNKNOWN`.
- `regionForPostcode` lines 96-114.
- `regionOfCustomerCode(customerCode)` lines 66-75: reads the region back off the code by taking the substring before the first `-`. Used by the mapper for `locality`/`timezone`/`ownerSegment`.
- `timezoneOfRegion` lines 91-93; `isKnownRegion` lines 81-83.

### HASH8 / SHA-256 — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/Sha256Hash.java`
- `upperHex(s, n)` lines 18-25: first `n` upper-case hex chars of SHA-256 over UTF-8 bytes.
- `digest` lines 27-34: `MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256")`.

### membershipNumber — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignMembershipNumber.java`
Lines 18-21. Format `<customerCode>-M<YY>`:
- `yy = String.format("%02d", FiscalYear.yearOf(owner.getRegistrationDate()) % 100)`
- `owner.setMembershipNumber(owner.getCustomerCode() + "-M" + yy)`

### Fiscal year — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/FiscalYear.java`
- `FISCAL_YEAR_START_MONTH = 7` (line 15).
- `yearOf(date)` lines 21-23: month >= July → year+1, else year.
- `labelOf(date)` lines 27-29: `FY<YY>`.
- `elapsedYears(from, to)` lines 33-35 (used by tenure scoring in `MembershipLevel`).

### checkDigit / Luhn — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/CheckDigit.java`
- `luhnOf(code)` lines 18-40: standard Luhn over the digits in `customerCode`, skipping non-digits, doubling every second from the right, returns `(10 - sum%10) % 10`. Returns null for null input.

---

## 3. Collision handling

Only one place — `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/function/owner/AssignCustomerCode.java` lines 38-47:
```
Set<String> existingCodes = new HashSet<>();
for (Owner other : ownerRepository.findAll()) {
    existingCodes.add(other.getCustomerCode());
}
String customerCode = baseCode;
for (int n = 2; existingCodes.contains(customerCode); n++) {
    customerCode = baseCode + "-" + n;
}
owner.setCustomerCode(customerCode);
```
Appends `-<n>` starting at 2 until unique (e.g. `NSW-3F1A9C2B-2`). Relies on running before `SaveOwner` so `findAll()` returns only pre-existing owners.

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          title: Title
          description: Optional honorific for the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or DR.
            When supplied it drives the derived 'salutation'. Stored and returned.
          type: string
          enum:
            - MR
            - MRS
            - MS
            - DR
          example: DR
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted as a flat value for
            backward compatibility, but when the structured fields are supplied it is composed
            from them and returned as the normalized 'addressLine1' with, when present, a single
            space and the normalized 'addressLine2' appended.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: First line of the structured postal address. Preferred over the flat
            'address' when supplied (non-blank). Normalized like 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: Optional second line of the structured postal address (e.g. unit or
            apartment). Normalized like 'address' and, when present, appended to the composed
            'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4B'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: Optional 4-digit postal code. When present it must be valid for the owner's
            city per the fixed region table (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099); a city
            with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored and returned when given.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^\+[0-9]{8,15}$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it must be
            a syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).
            Optional on create; when omitted the server defaults it to the current date. The
            effective date (supplied or defaulted) must fall on a business day, so a Saturday or
            Sunday is rolled forward to the following Monday before it is stored and returned.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth, in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional; when
            present it is stored and returned, and drives the derived 'ageBand'.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: Request-only hint. When true, permits creating this owner even when
            another owner already exists in the same household (same last name and postcode);
            such an owner is created as a declared household member and is not flagged as a
            possible duplicate. When false (the default) a second owner in an existing household
            is rejected with 409. Does not affect the assigned householdId, which is derived
            purely from the last name and postcode. Not persisted or returned.
          type: boolean
          example: true
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            salutation:
              title: Salutation
              description: The owner's salutation, formatted as the 'title' followed by a single
                space and the lastName (e.g. 'DR who'); just the lastName when no title was given.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName,
                dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 'telephone' formatted for humans, as the country
                code, a space, then the national digits grouped in threes (e.g. '+61412345678'
                becomes '+61 412 345 678'). The raw 'telephone' stays in E.164 form.
              type: string
              example: '+61 412 345 678'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: Assigned membership code formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>', where
                CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of city, LAST3 is the upper-cased
                first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a per-city 4-digit zero-padded
                sequence (one more than the owners already in that city).
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            checkDigit:
              title: Check digit
              description: A single Luhn check digit (0-9) computed over the digits contained in
                the owner's customerCode.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              maximum: 9
              example: 4
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: Assigned membership number formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>', where
                customerCode is the owner's customer code and YY is the last two digits of the
                fiscal year (starting 1 July) of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M27'
              readOnly: true
            fiscalYear:
              title: Fiscal year
              description: The owner's fiscal year, formatted 'FY<YY>', where YY is the last two
                digits of the fiscal year of the business-day-adjusted registrationDate. The fiscal
                year starts on 1 July, so a July-December date belongs to the fiscal year ending in
                the following calendar year, numbered by that ending year (e.g. 1 July 2026 is FY27).
              type: string
              example: 'FY27'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: Stable shared identifier for owners in the same household, derived
                deterministically as the first 12 hex characters of SHA-256 over the normalized last
                name, a '|' separator and the postcode, so every owner with the same last name and
                postcode shares it automatically (no opt-in required).
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the time this owner was created,
                shared the same firstName and lastName (compared case-insensitively). Computed
                once at creation before this owner is persisted, then stored and returned.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipPoints:
              title: Membership points
              description: The owner's membership points, derived from the stored fields. Starts at
                0 and adds 2 when an email is present, 1 when namesakeCount is 0, 2 for a household
                of 3 or more members, and 3 when tenure (fiscal years, starting 1 July, elapsed from
                registrationDate to today) exceeds 1.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 3
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, mapped from membershipPoints as
                1 (0-1 points), 2 (2-3), 3 (4-5) and 4 (6 or more).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The owner's region, derived from the city using a fixed city-to-region
                table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD). 'UNKNOWN' for any other city.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:
              title: Timezone
              description: The owner's IANA timezone name, derived from the locality/region using a
                fixed region-to-timezone table (NSW->Australia/Sydney, VIC->Australia/Melbourne,
                QLD->Australia/Brisbane). Absent when the region is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'Australia/Sydney'
              readOnly: true
            ownerSegment:
              title: Owner segment
              description: The owner's marketing segment, formatted '<TIER>_<AREA>'. TIER is
                'PREMIUM' when membershipLevel is 3 or more, otherwise 'STANDARD'. AREA is 'METRO'
                when the locality is a known region (NSW, VIC or QLD), otherwise 'REGIONAL'. One of
                'PREMIUM_METRO', 'PREMIUM_REGIONAL', 'STANDARD_METRO' or 'STANDARD_REGIONAL'.
              type: string
              example: 'STANDARD_METRO'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created on this owner's
                registration day, signalling an unusually high signup volume; otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            capacityWarning:
              title: Capacity warning
              description: True when the owner's city already holds between 40 and 49 owners
                (inclusive), signalling it is approaching the hard capacity limit of 50; otherwise
                false. The city is compared case-insensitively.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            ageBand:
              title: Age band
              description: The owner's age band, derived from 'birthDate' as of the
                'registrationDate'. 'MINOR' when under 18, 'ADULT' from 18 to 64 inclusive, and
                'SENIOR' at 65 or older. Absent when no birthDate was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'ADULT'
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, derived from the stored fields.
                'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: The owner's derived identity key, formatted
                '<normalizedTelephone>|<email or empty>|<householdId>', where normalizedTelephone
                is the E.164 telephone, the email component is the lower-cased email or empty, and
                householdId is the deterministic identifier for the owner's household (derived from
                the last name and postcode).
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678|george.franklin@example.com|A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicate:
              title: Possible duplicate
              description: True when this owner, though not rejected as a household duplicate, was
                created sharing an existing owner's lastName and postcode while carrying a different
                telephone; otherwise false. A declared household member ('sharesHousehold' true) is
                never flagged. Computed once at creation, then stored and returned.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            possibleDuplicateOf:
              title: Possible duplicate of
              description: When 'possibleDuplicate' is true, the id of the existing owner whose
                lastName and postcode this owner shares; absent otherwise.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            selfLink:
              title: Self link
              description: Canonical relative URL of this owner, formatted '/api/owners/<id>'
                using the owner's own id.
              type: string
              example: '/api/owners/7'
              readOnly: true
            deleted:
              title: Deleted
              description: Whether this owner has been soft-deleted. A newly created owner is
                false; DELETE /owners/{id} sets it true while retaining the record. Deleted owners
                are ignored by the create endpoint's duplicate and identity checks.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - deleted
            - pets
